svg.title: SLIC: a small language model iteratively optimizing an analog circuit
svg.desc: Left: a compact glass chip holding a small glowing neural network, representing a small language model. Right: a glass panel showing a five-transistor operational transconductance amplifier. Tapered red light-streak arrows carry design proposals from the model to the circuit and blue streaks carry simulation feedback back, three turns growing brighter; behind the schematic, frequency-response curves approach a dashed target.
